claims: Made Fresh Salads, Inc. is recalling assorted flavors of cream cheese and tofu spread in 5 lb. white plastic tubs.
The recall by Made Fresh Salads, Inc. is due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination.
The recall by Made Fresh Salads, Inc. was announced on February 20, 2026.
The products recalled by Made Fresh Salads, Inc. were distributed to retail stores and distributors in Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, and New York City.
The products recalled by Made Fresh Salads, Inc. have expiration dates through February 27, 2026.
Rizo-López Foods, Inc. initiated a large recall of dairy products in February 2024 due to Listeria risk.
Hy-Vee, Inc. conducted a voluntary recall of specific cream cheese spreads and dips in May 2024 due to potential Salmonella contamination.
Schreiber Foods/Aldi conducted recalls in 2024 for specific cream cheese spreads sold at Aldi in several states due to Salmonella.
